商品描述
Threadmill Home Linen Sheet Set
✨ Elevate Your Bedroom with Threadmill ✨
Threadmill 300 Thread Count 100% Cotton Jacquard Sheet Set offers softness and breathability. Crafted from pure long staple cotton, these sheets provide lightweight comfort and breathable relaxation. Perfect for a peaceful night’s sleep, they feature an elegant jacquard weave for timeless style and durability. The breathable cotton fabric keeps you cool and comfortable throughout the year.
Premium Features
·Soft & Breathable: 100% pure long staple cotton.
·Elegant Design: Jacquard weave for style and durability.
·Secure Fit: Ensures a neat and comfortable bedding experience.
·Sustainable: OEKO-TEX certified, made without harmful chemicals.
What's Included
·2 Pillow Cases
·1 Fitted Sheet
·1 Flat Sheet
Enjoy quality, comfort, and classic elegance with Threadmill’s cotton jacquard bedding collection.
